rows.title: The subscription resolves from the user's own charges
rows.defect: with two matches the first is taken silently

rows.title: The purchase channel decides the route
rows.defect: the purchase channel is ignored, so a store-billed subscription is routed to the merchant
rows.test: a store-billed subscription goes to the store route

rows.title: Terms are read before the card
rows.defect: a three-day-old account read is accepted as the terms
rows.test: a stale account read means no card

rows.title: One card through the card layer with a 10-minute expiry
rows.defect: an expired card leaves the loop waiting, so the next request is refused as busy
rows.test: after an expired card the next request gets a fresh card

rows.title: One approval per cancellation
rows.defect: the batch drops everything after the first subscription
rows.test: a batch queues the rest behind the first card

rows.title: Execution goes through the loop once
rows.defect: the session forgets what it already cancelled and leans on the loop's generic answer
rows.test: the same cancellation twice answers already done with the confirmation

rows.title: Done means the merchant's record says cancelled
rows.defect: the evidence check is dropped; the record state alone makes it cancelled
rows.test: a cancelled record with no captured confirmation is not confirmed

rows.title: A plan-change page stops the run
rows.defect: a tripwire stop is reported as a plain failure
rows.test: the tripwire is reported with the offer

rows.title: OTP is a bounded continuation
rows.defect: the OTP window is not enforced
rows.test: a code after 30 minutes is refused

rows.title: The receipt carries the proof
rows.defect: the receipt drops the confirmation reference
rows.test: the receipt names the confirmation reference

rows.title: The feed verifies the claim
rows.defect: a charge after the cancellation is reported but the claim stays open and the savings stand
rows.test: a charge after the claim makes it a zombie

rows.title: Refund where eligible
rows.defect: refund eligibility is ignored and every cancellation requests one
rows.test: no refund is requested under a no-refund policy

rows.title: Failure in one message, no blind retry
rows.test: the second failure at the same merchant stops retries

rows.title: Undo and reactivation
rows.defect: the reinstatement window is not checked
rows.test: undo after the reinstatement window is refused honestly

rows.title: Savings honesty
rows.defect: projected savings are counted as verified
rows.test: savings the day after are projected, not verified

rows.title: Stop-on-change
rows.defect: the re-verification result is ignored, so a new cancellation fee still runs
rows.test: a changed fee or access date between yes and run stops it
